title: Independent Contractor (Spanish/English) Transcription/Translation
description:
What you will do:
As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.
We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.
Who we’re looking for:

• U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.

• Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.

• Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.

• People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

• Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.

• Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

• A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.

• For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.

• Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.

• ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?
No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

• Current resume (PDF)

• Cover letter (PDF)

• A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. About the Role

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a Digital Experience Lead to help drive its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role focused on improving conversion across our landing pages and customer journeys.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way. With significant investment across paid acquisition, getting the experience right from the moment a customer lands with us is critical.

You’ll work closely with SEM, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to understand customer behaviour, identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into experiments and improvements that drive measurable commercial impact.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics - including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data - accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're seeking engineers to utilize advanced technology in agile settings, with a focus on improving the customer experience for every collector.

Collectors Cybersecurity team is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand.

We’re looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and drive secure by default architectures and ensure the security and integrity of our infrastructure.
You’ll join our Cybersecurity Team and work from our Santa Ana, CA office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.

What You’ll Do:

•
Drive Detection Engineering: Build, tune and manage high-confidence detections across cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), enterprise tooling (Okta, GWS, M365) and vendor products. Treat detections as code: version controlled, peer reviewed, tested in CI, and measured for precision and coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.

•
Incident Command and Containment: Serve as a senior responder for security incidents, driving triage, containment, forensics, and remediation, and authoring post-incident reviews that turn lessons into durable improvements.

•
Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat hunts across cloud, SaaS, identity and on-prem infrastructure, converting hypotheses and findings into new detections and hardened controls.

•
Tooling and Response Automation: Design and build automation and SOAR playbooks that reduce manual toil, accelerate response times, and improve alert enrichment and case management.

•
Security Telemetry : Own and improve the health of the security data pipeline

First American Bank was founded in Chicago, and over the years has expanded throughout Wisconsin and Florida. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

- You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

- Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

- A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

- Experience at a fast-growing technology company

COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Credit Risk Analyst Commercial Underwriter
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team is responsible for managing the credit risk generated by businesses processing payments on Stripe. The team combines commercial underwriting, portfolio management, analytics, and cross-functional partnership to protect Stripe from financial loss while enabling strong businesses to grow. The APAC Credit Risk team supports a diverse portfolio of businesses across the region. We partner closely with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Operations, and other Risk teams to make sound, timely credit decisions and develop scalable approaches to managing risk.

What you’ll do

You will underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC. You will evaluate complex business models and financial information, develop clear credit recommendations, and identify mitigations that protect Stripe while supporting sustainable user growth.

Responsibilities

• Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing businesses across APAC.

• Evaluate business models, financial statements, cash-flow forecasts, transaction patterns, and other relevant information to assess credit risk.

• Develop clear, data-driven credit recommendations and tailored risk mitigations that balance Stripe’s exposure with users’ ability to grow.

• Build expertise across APAC industries, geographies, payment flows, and operating models, and apply this context to underwriting and portfolio decisions.

• Provide credit insights that support onboarding, ongoing portfolio management, commercial decisions, and merchant-pricing analysis.

• Conduct periodic and trigger-based reviews, identify changes in risk, and recommend timely actions to manage Stripe’s exposure.

• Support the refinement of systems, tools, and processes to help the team deliver on key performance indicators, such as credit loss targets or portfolio coverage metrics.

• Communicate credit decisions, risk considerations, and mitigation requirements clearly to internal stakeholders and to users, including CFOs and CEOs.

• Partner with Sales, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Risk teams to resolve complex cases and improve Stripe’s credit-risk capabilities.

• Identify recurring portfolio trends and underwriting gaps, and translate these insights into improvements to policies, controls, and decision frameworks.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial credit underwriting, financial-risk modeling, cash-flow forecasting, or portfolio credit risk.

• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong accounting knowledge and demonstrated ability to evaluate financial statements, cash flows, business models, and sources of repayment.

• Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into a clear credit-risk narrative, approval rationale, and mitigation strategy.

• Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance financial-risk considerations with user growth and business objectives.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex credit decisions to senior inter

Senior Employment Solicitor (Consultant)

We are looking for an experienced Employment Solicitor with a minimum of 10 years’ PQE and strong contentious and non-contentious experience to join Harper James on a consultancy basis.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with a growing and diverse client base ranging from innovative start-ups to established national and international businesses.

You will advise on a wide range of employment law matters within a modern, tech-enabled law firm. As a consultant within our flexible model, you will manage your own caseload while benefiting from the support, infrastructure and collaborative culture of a forward-thinking national firm.

What you’ll be doing

You will take the lead on a broad range of contentious and non-contentious employment matters, supporting businesses with day-to-day workforce issues, strategic projects and employment disputes.

You will work closely with founders, senior leadership teams, HR teams and in-house counsel, providing clear, pragmatic advice that helps clients manage risk and achieve their commercial objectives.

Your work is likely to include advising on matters such as general day-to-day employment law support to SMEs and larger companies;

• business restructures & redundancies (including collective);

• overseeing discrimination and whistle-blowing cases;

• advising on TUPE transfers, including corporate support;

• drafting consultancy agreements and advising on status (with a good knowledge of IR35);

• drafting and advising on director service agreements and contracts of employment;

• managing disciplinary and grievance processes; and

• handling senior exec severances.

As part of the wider Harper James legal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across Corporate, Commercial and other practice areas, particularly where employment issues intersect with transactions, business growth and organisational change.

What we’re looking for

• A minimum of 10 years’ PQE with strong experience across both contentious and non-contentious employment law

• Demonstrable experience advising employers on complex workforce issues and managing Employment Tribunal litigation

• Experience advising founder-led businesses, start-ups and scale-ups would be advantageous

• Ability to manage matters independently and deliver pragmatic, commercially focused advicel

• Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills

The Harper James difference

We are a tech-driven, agile law firm where lawyers are empowered with modern legal technology to maximise efficiency, productivity and work-life balance.

Our consultant model offers experienced solicitors flexibility, autonomy and the ability to work remotely, while remaining part of a supportive national team.

At Harper James , we keep things straightforward. We are relaxed and informal but well organised. There is no politics and no big egos - if people around us succeed, so do we. We welcome proactive, self-motivated solicitors who thrive in a modern legal environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional client service.

You’ll excel as part of the HJ team if you

• Are a quick learner, ready to adapt to new systems and technologies

• Are interested in using AI tools to improve efficiency and productivity

• Have a solid working knowledge of Microsoft 365 products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Can confidently navigate SharePoint to manage and collaborate on work

• Have a keen eye for detail when drafting documents, ensuring consistency and professionalism

The bottom line

This is an opportunity to play an important part in the continued growth of the business, working alongside a great team of people who all contribute to our shared success.

We are offering a competitive consultancy rate with flexibility and autonomy as part of the Harper James consultant model.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE

We combine generative ML, physics based simulation (e.g. DFT and molecular dynamics), Large Quantitative Models for property prediction, and multi-scale modeling with a partner driven experimental validation loop. You will work alongside industrial co-development partners to move candidate molecules from prediction to qualified use.

Introduction to the role: The PFAS team is hiring Machine Learning Scientists to own machine learned force fields (MLFFs) for the PFAS substitution programme, including generating the first principles data they are trained on. Machine learned potentials are the load bearing element of our discovery pipeline: the properties that decide whether a candidate molecule can replace a PFAS incumbent - among them reactivity, thermal stability, and the diffusivity through polymer matrices - are ones that the physics based simulations can compute accurately but far too slowly to screen a library, and that classical force fields compute quickly but may not be accurate enough to trust. In this role you will: (1) design and run the high-throughput quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics campaigns that produce our training data, and own the infrastructure that makes them reproducible; (2) train, validate, and deploy the potentials that data supports, and identify where each model's domain of validity ends; and (3) extend machine learned potentials into the chemistry that PFAS substitution requires.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

• Bring substantial experience in a technical IT role, including experience in IT engineering or systems administration.

• Build integrations and automation using Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs and scripting languages such as Python and Bash.

• Use infrastructure or configuration as code with Git-based workflows, including pull requests and code review.

• Demonstrate experience applying AI to accelerate or replace team workflows, while managing project timelines, risks, stakeholder communication, and organizational change.

• Bring experience managing an IdP with Terraform, using 1Password Enterprise and Device Trust, or supporting Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), or ISO 27001 audits.

What you can expect:

• Operate and improve Okta, including tenant configuration, policies, lifecycle management, and complex identity issues.

• Lead IAM initiatives from concept through rollout, including role-based access control, access reviews, and onboarding and offboarding automation.

• Build safeguards that make identity and access changes safer to deploy and easier to audit.

• Design durable application integrations

title: Founding Engineer
description: Subimage (YC W25) | Founding Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE (5 days/week) | Full-time | $170K-$230K + 0.5%-1.0% equity | https://subimage.io Hihi, I'm Alex, co-founder and CEO. Subimage maps infrastructure the way an attacker does so security teams at scale-ups and enterprises can find and fix problems. We're built on Cartography ( https://cartography.dev ), the open source infra mapping tool we helped create at Lyft and donated to the CNCF. It runs at over 70 companies, including 7 in the Fortune 100. We're a tiny seed-stage team and our customers are companies your parents have heard of. We have more demand than we can build for, which is why this post exists. This is a chance to get in on the ground floor of something big (or to find out quickly that it won't work; just being upfront about it). Some of the problems you'd be working on: - Vulnerability triage with real context: is the asset internet-facing, through which services, is the vulnerable function actually reachable in code, are there compensating controls, and what sensitive data does it reach once exploited, across how many hops. - Proving that the security fixes our agent proposes won't break anything. - A near-real-time, self-updating map of an environment so you can see an attack as it happens, plus "time travel" in the graph so you can replay it afterward. - Teaching an agent to answer questions about a large graph quickly, with only the context it needs and without making mistakes. - Determining who owns a given resource from messy signals like tags, actions, logs, and files. Stack: Cartography for ingestion, Neo4j for the graph, Python/FastAPI backend, Svelte frontend with a homegrown WebGL graph renderer, an MCP server that exposes all of it to agents, Terraform for IaC. Who we're looking for: 3+ years at high-growth companies, strong distributed systems and cloud experience, a real sense of ownership, first-principles thinking, and a willingness to implement gnarly business logic (elegantly, ideally) if it makes a jaded security engineer's life easier. Kubernetes and security knowledge are nice to have, not required. You're in the Bay Area and want to be in the office five days a week. Process: technical screen, call with the founders, a paid day working with the team, then offer. Health/vision/dental, 401k match, gym, team lunches, unlimited PTO. You're not a feature narrator. You teach why a demo is structured the way it is, what questions it's built to answer, and how to prove our value rather than just claim it. You'll partner closely with Product, PMM, Competitive Intelligence, and Enablement Programs to take in what's new, but you'll own how that knowledge is trained, framed, and put to work in the field. And you'll love owning the room, whether that's new hire bootcamp, a virtual session, or the main stage at an offsite.

Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. In July 2026, we extended our Behavioral AI platform beyond email into identity and AI security with the launch of Identity Threat Protection, Infiltration Prevention, and AI Governance. Choose clarity over completeness. Ruthlessly prioritize clarity and seller application over feature coverage, and keep refining content based on field feedback and observed execution.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Account Executive to own Australia and New Zealand across our commercial and enterprise segments. You’ll sell to founders, engineering leaders, and technical buyers, and you’ll move between a two person startup in Auckland and a regulated enterprise in Sydney in the same week. We’re after someone who has done this before, enjoys the technical depth of the work, and wants to help define how Supabase sells in the region.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close, including multi threaded enterprise deals

- Run technical discovery and tie it to business outcomes the buyer cares about

- Work with Sales Engineers and Product on demos, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews

- Help customers see where Supabase fits in their stack and what it replaces

- Build and run your own ANZ territory plan, including pipeline, forecasting, and account strategy

- Work with AWS and regional partners and resellers to open and progress deals

- Handle data residency, security, and procurement conversations with enterprise and public sector buyers

- Hand off to Customer Success so customers onboard well and expand

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years in a technical sales role, ideally selling developer tools, databases, cloud infrastructure, or open source

- A record of consistently beating quota, with numbers you can walk us through

- Experience closing both fast moving commercial deals and longer enterprise cycles with procurement, security, and legal involved

- Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with an engineer without bringing a Sales Engineer to every call

- Comfort selling to founders, CTOs, and platform teams

- Strong judgment about where to spend your time across a territory spanning two countries and several time zones

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Postgres, or a competing backend or database platform

- An existing network across the ANZ startup, scale-up, and developer ecosystem

- Experience with cloud marketplace or co-sell motions, particularly AWS

- Familiarity with ANZ compliance expectations, such as Australian Privacy Act, NZ Privacy Act, or financial services and government requirements

WHY SUPABASE

You’ll sell a product developers already love, with real inbound demand and a fast growing open source community behind it. The territory is yours, the ownership is real, and the team is small enough that your ideas get used rather than filed.

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Pretraining Data
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PRETRAINING DATA

We're looking for Senior Software Engineers to build and own the data systems behind our frontier models' initial training. You'll work on large-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. As a senior engineer, you'll set technical direction for these systems, lead projects across teams, and mentor other engineers as our pretraining data scales.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Data Platform: Design, build, and scale the distributed infrastructure that transforms raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training-ready datasets for frontier model pretraining. Own high-throughput data pipelines, orchestration systems, and tooling that enable fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible data processing at massive scale, with end-to-end visibility into data lineage, freshness, and pipeline health.

- Data Quality: Build and deploy high-performance models and algorithms to classify, rank, deduplicate, filter, and clean training data at extreme throughput. Design and execute rigorous experiments across data mixtures, sampling strategies, and quality thresholds to quantify their impact on training loss, downstream evaluations, and model capabilities, translating research findings into production systems.

- Crawling: Build and optimize large-scale web crawling infrastructure spanning URL discovery, prioritization, host scheduling, fetching, parsing, and content extraction. Improve crawl coverage, efficiency, and reliability through intelligent scheduling, anti-bot resilience, robust extraction systems, and automated recovery, ensuring high-quality web data flows seamlessly into downstream training pipelines.

- Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead complex engineering initiatives across Data Platform, Data Quality, Crawling, Acquisition, and model training teams. Influence technical direction, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and translate improvements in data infrastructure, coverage, and quality into measurable gains in model performance.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems and/or large-scale data infrastructure

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Strong infrastructure or data platform background, ideally with a spike of outlier depth

- High-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast (e.g., staff-level ownership within a few years) or brings relevant domain experience

- Able to architect and ship end-to-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents

- Strong intuitions about large-scale distributed systems, including running them reliably at frontier scale

- Track record of leading technical projects across teams and mentoring other engineers

- Excited to learn how pre-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs

- Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.
This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara ’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.
You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

•
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

•
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara , you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara . This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.

• Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.

• Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.

• Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.

• Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.

• Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.

• Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.

• Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.

• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.

About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions-so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows-and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative-because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable-those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work-while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role
Abacus is scaling fast - more Data Solutions applications, more agent-assisted engineering, more complexity worth getting right. We’re creating this role to put a strong technical voice at the center of that growth: someone who can take sharp architectural judgment and turn it into standards the whole organization can build on with confidence.
We’re looking for an experienced Software Architect to help set the technical vision for how Abacus builds, secures, and scales its healthcare data platform & data applications platform. This is an individual-contributor role, not a management track - you’ll be the architecture guru and evangelist for our platform, translating business and customer needs into target-state architectures across data, applications, cloud, and agent-assisted engineering, and sharing your expertise with engineers and Solution Architects as you go.
We’re excited to meet architects at a range of career stages. Whether you’re a mid-level seasoned architect ready to step into broader scope, a senior architect with a track record of leading complex designs, or a principal-level leader who has shaped architecture across an organization, we’d love to hear from you. We’ll meet you where you are and shape the scope of the role to the level where you can make the biggest impact.
Our platform is built for health plans, and we’re especially excited to hear from architects who’ve worked with healthcare data.
You’ll build the reusable application foundation - application blueprints, integration contracts, and production-readiness gates - that lets Data Solutions applications move fast without reinventing the wheel every time, create re-usable assets. And as agent-driven development becomes a bigger part of how we ship, you’ll be the one turning architecture standards into skills, rules, templates, and evaluation rubrics that let AI-assisted output meet the same bar as our best human-written code - putting you at the center of how Abacus builds software for years to come.
You’ll bring enough depth to guide decisions across data, application, integration, cloud, and agentic development, while staying pragmatic about fit-for-purpose architecture and delivery constraints. You won’t do it alone - you’ll partner closely with Product Engineering, our Principal Engineers, AI Engineering, Security, and Client Solutions, bringing architecture to life from concept through production, not just on a whiteboard.
